source_line: Source: American Farm Bureau Federation, 2026 survey (Nov 18)
caption:
A classic Thanksgiving dinner for 10 costs $58.63 this year — about $5.86 a plate.

That's up 6% from last year, the first increase since 2022, per the American Farm Bureau Federation's 41st annual survey. The driver: a 16-pound frozen turkey now averages $23.68, up $2.38 (10%).

The upside — it's still more than 8% below the 2022 record. And where you live matters: the Northeast averages $61.57 a dinner while the South comes in at $54.33.

My take: when the centerpiece is the thing getting pricier, there's no easy swap. The turkey is the bill.
